title: Prospective real-SWAP F-GC30 response-versus-storage scan

fixed_fixture.bottom_flux_rule: predictor bottom flux equals configured q_bot

preregistered_relations: for one 1 m2 tile, HCOF = u/duration_day in m2/day
RHS = HCOF*H_ref - 0.01*q_u_cm_per_day for the 1 m2 single-tile reference-head representation
predictor physical mass identity: storage_change = total_in-total_out+mass_residual
gates: all nine configured real-SWAP predictors initialize successfully and publish complete mass diagnostics
all nine satisfy the q_u reconstruction to 256 machine eps on an appropriate scale
all nine satisfy HCOF=u/duration_day and the F-GC33 RHS transform to 256 machine eps on an appropriate scale
all nine satisfy the independent SWAP mass identity within 1e-12 native storage units
because top and bottom forcing are equal in this fixture, all nine have |storage_change| <= 1e-12 native units
all nine have finite nonzero u with |u| > 1e-12, demonstrating nonzero coupling response with zero net inventory change
characterization_only: variation of q_u and lower-face head response
forbidden: do not retune matrix after observation
do not infer monotonicity unless separately justified
do not generalize from this drainage-free near-equilibrium family to all SWAP regimes
do not infer a production MODFLOW tolerance
